addons.name: Bitwarden
addons.summary: Password manager that syncs your logins across devices.

addons.name: Proton Pass
addons.summary: Password manager from Proton with built-in email aliases.

addons.name: KeePassXC-Browser
addons.summary: Fills logins from the KeePassXC app on your computer (the app is required).

addons.name: Privacy Badger
addons.summary: Learns which trackers follow you around and blocks them.

addons.name: LocalCDN
addons.summary: Serves common web libraries from your computer instead of from big CDNs.

addons.name: NoScript
addons.summary: Blocks JavaScript and other active content unless you allow a site.
addons.note: Blocks scripts until you allow them; expect sites to need a click.

addons.name: Consent-O-Matic
addons.summary: Answers cookie consent pop-ups for you, choosing the minimum.

addons.name: Firefox Multi-Account Containers
addons.summary: Keeps sites in separate colored containers so they cannot see each other.

addons.name: Facebook Container
addons.summary: Keeps Facebook and Instagram in their own container, away from the rest of your browsing.

addons.name: ProtonMail Launcher
addons.summary: Adds a toolbar button that opens Proton Mail.

addons.name: ProtonMail Notifier
addons.summary: Shows your unread Proton Mail count on a toolbar button.
addons.note: Third-party add-on that reads your mailbox session.

addons.name: Gmail Notifier
addons.summary: Shows your unread Gmail count on a toolbar button.
addons.note: Third-party add-on that reads your mailbox session.

addons.name: SponsorBlock
addons.summary: Skips sponsor segments and other filler in YouTube videos.

addons.name: Return YouTube Dislike
addons.summary: Shows the dislike count on YouTube videos again.

addons.name: Tabliss
addons.summary: A calm, customizable new tab page.

addons.name: nightTab
addons.summary: A new tab page with your own bookmarks, themes and layout.
